sandbachFocus: Sandbach United maintained their winning form with a commanding 3-1 victory over Cheadle Heath Nomads at home. After falling behind early, they turned the game around spectacularly through goals from Fowles, Birchall, and a penalty from Hatton to secure all three points and retain top spot in the table. The win extended their remarkable league record to nine wins from twelve games, keeping them firmly at the summit with 28 points.
divisionWide: Stafford Town produced an impressive 6-2 demolition of Wednesfield Community in the second half, with Greer and Parker particularly prominent in attack as Town moved to within four points of leaders Sandbach. Allscott Heath claimed a 2-1 half-time lead over Brereton Social with Ben Summers scoring twice. Barnton mounted a comeback against Dawley Town, pulling one back through Sigsworth after being 2-0 down, though Dawley had reduced to ten men following a red card. Market Drayton Town dominated Widnes Town in the first half despite being down to ten themselves after Widnes received a red card for an incident involving a punch; the match was goalless at the break with Drayton having created numerous chances. Telford Town drew 1-1 with New Mills at half-time, while Alsager Town fell behind to Shawbury United, who scored through Conor T Hughes in the 38th minute continuing his recent goalscoring streak. Bilston Town prepared to face Crewe, and the match details remain to be confirmed.
